youtube.title: All the ants | Possibility Lab No. 003
youtube.caption:
Ants, or us: who weighs more? Every ant on Earth, on one scale.

So the ants should win. But a real ant is tinier than the old guess assumed, and once they're weighed properly, all of them together come to only about a fifth of us. So we win on the scale, by a lot. But they win on the count.

Series: Season 1: Impossible, worked out, part 3 of 6.

Sources
1. In 1994, Bert Hölldobler and E. O. Wilson estimated about 10^16 ants alive at once and that all ants together weigh about as much as all humans. — serendipstudio.org: https://serendipstudio.org/~pgrobste/panama/SwarmIntel_files/slide0003.htm
2. Schultheiss et al. (2022) compiled 489 field studies of ground-dwelling ant counts across biomes and estimated about 20 × 10^15 ants: about twice the 1994 figure. — pnas.org: https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2201550119
3. 12 Mt of ant carbon is about 20% of humanity's 60 Mt (0.06 Gt C). — pnas.org: https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.1711842115
4. About 2 × 10^16 ants for 8.2 billion people is about 2.4 million ants per person; said and shown as 'about two and a half million' (to the nearest half million). — phys.org: https://phys.org/news/2022-09-ants-earth-quadrillion.html
5. Published estimates of global ant biomass span about 3.6–50 Mt of carbon; even the highest is about 83% of humanity's 60 Mt. — NCBI (NIH): https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9586285/
6. The world's population is about 8.2 billion (mid-2024), the divisor in c6's 2e16 ÷ 8.2e9 ≈ 2.44 million ants a person. — un.org: https://www.un.org/development/desa/pd/world-population-prospects-2024

Narration: synthetic voice (AI). Animation: code-rendered, no stock footage. Every number is checked against the sources.

Possibility Lab: Impossible questions, honest assumptions, real calculations.

instagram.caption:
Ants, or us: who weighs more? Every ant on Earth, on one scale.

Scientists now count about 20 quadrillion ants, twice the old guess. But each ant is so light that all of them together weigh only about a fifth of all humans. We win on the scale. They win on the count.

Season 1: Impossible, worked out, part 3 of 6.

Sources in the first comment. Synthetic (AI) narration; code-rendered animation.
